Indian athletes object to incomplete map at Glasgow restaurant

A controversy erupted at an Indian restaurant in Glasgow during the Commonwealth Games 2026 when napkins featuring an incomplete map of India, omitting the Northeast region, were served. Indian athletes, including boxer Lovlina Borgohain, expressed their anger over the depiction. The incident led to public criticism of the restaurant on social media.
